# Running the challenge

There are two ways to reach the panel. They are the same puzzle, so use whichever
suits you. Figure out what the panel is and return it to its calibrated state.

## Browser (any OS)

Open the link on the challenge page. Nothing to install. Your progress is kept
for your browser session, and the panel takes keyboard input, so click into the
page first. Press Esc for the controls.

## Linux x86-64

Download `calibration_sequence`, then:

    chmod +x calibration_sequence
    ./calibration_sequence

It opens a graphical window, so you need a desktop / X session.
